company.shortDescription: In Your Corner is a marketplace for online counseling and coaching services.
company.description: In Your Corner is a marketplace for online counseling and coaching services. Through a secure, HIPAA-compliant platform, their service connects users with a carefully curated team of wellness professionals. By conducting online consultations via video chat, written journals, and even texting sessions, they have transformed traditional therapy into an experience that is low-cost, convenient, and completely confidential.
